OneLineDescription: Adds high heel footstep sounds to armor that HHS or HO3 already marks as heels
LongDescription:
Automatically sets the ArmorAddon footstep set to the high heel footstep set from 'High Heel Sounds' (https://www.nexusmods.com/fallout4/mods/45345) for every armor that already carries a heel height.

Heel heights are read from four sources:
- HHS txt files next to the mesh (Height=13.1)
- HHS json files in Data/F4SE/Plugins/HHS
- HHS NiFloatExtraData named 'HHS' inside the mesh
- HO3 / HHSOutfit3 VMAD script property 'HHSHeight' on the Armor record

Both loose files and BA2 archives are searched. Configurable minimum/maximum heel height, per-source toggles, regex blacklists on armor name and editor id, biped slot filtering and a dry run mode.

Requires 'High Heel Sounds' (HighHeelSounds.esm) for the default footstep set, but any FootstepSet can be selected in the settings.
